- Cells where col < row: white

<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# The diamond brush rotations all produce the same pattern because the canvas

# Let me switch to rectangle brush and stamp white on the right half to reset.

action(['DOWN'])

print("After DOWN (rectangle brush):")

    if n['pixels'] > 30 and n['pixels'] < 200:
        print(f"  Node {n['id']}: color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, hash={n['hash']}")

    line = ascii_lines[i][27:37]
    print(f"Row {i-34}: {line}")

# Now try rotating the rectangle brush with RIGHT
action(['RIGHT'])

print("\nAfter RIGHT:")

    if n['pixels'] > 30 and n['pixels'] < 200:
        print(f"  Node {n['id']}: color={n['color']}, pixels={n['pixels']}, hash={n['hash']}")

# Stamp purple to see the pattern
action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 4, 'col': 43}, 'SPACE'])

ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("\nAfter purple stamp (rectangle, 1 RIGHT):")
for i in range(34, 44):
    line = ascii_lines[i][27:37]
    print(f"Row {i-34}: {line}")

# Check if this is the target
wc = sum(1 for i in range(34, 44) for j in range(27, 37) if ascii_lines[i][j] == 'W')
pc = sum(1 for i in range(34, 44) for j in range(27, 37) if ascii_lines[i][j] == 'p')
top_white = all(ascii_lines[i][j] == 'W' for i in range(34, 39) for j in range(27, 37))
bottom_purple = all(ascii_lines[i][j] == 'p' for i in range(39, 44) for j in range(27, 37))
print(f"White: {wc}, Purple: {pc}")
print(f"Top white: {top_white}, Bottom purple: {bottom_purple}")
print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed', False)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
